components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Signal-red action with cut corners and a travelling sheen; one per view.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary">Explore the work <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 12h15M13 6l6 6-6 6"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid transparent; background: var(--signal, #ff2d2d); color: var(--on-signal, #0a0206); font-family: var(--font-mono, "IBM Plex Mono", monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(12px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 12px), calc(100% - 12px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 12px); overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, translate 0.2s var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)), filter 0.24s ease; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(105deg, transparent 20%, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.55) 50%, transparent 80%); translate: -130% 0; transition: translate 0.55s var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); pointer-events: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--signal-hot, #ff7066); translate: 0 -1px; filter: drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 255 45 45) / 0.55)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before { translate: 130% 0; } .ds-btn-primary:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7ef6ff); outline-offset: 3px; clip-path: none; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.55; filter: none; translate: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Hairline companion action that never competes with the primary.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 50px; padding: 0 24px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(160, 190, 255, 0.3)); background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.02); color: var(--ink, #f2f5fb); font-family: var(--font-mono, "IBM Plex Mono", monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(12px 0, 100% 0, 100% calc(100% - 12px), calc(100% - 12px) 100%, 0 100%, 0 12px); overflow: hidden; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, background-color 0.2s ease, translate 0.2s var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--line-signal, rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.45)); background: rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 255 45 45) / 0.08); translate: 0 -1px; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7ef6ff); outline-offset: 3px; clip-path: none; }

components.name: Text Link
components.description: Mono 11px action with a red underline that grows from a quarter width.
components.html: Explore directions
components.css: .ds-link { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; min-height: 44px; padding-bottom: 2px; color: var(--ink, #f2f5fb); font-family: var(--font-mono, "IBM Plex Mono", monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; } .ds-link::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 0; bottom: 8px; left: 0; height: 1px; background: var(--signal, #ff2d2d); box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 255 45 45) / 0.7); transform: scaleX(0.22); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.26s var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-link:hover::after, .ds-link:focus-visible::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-link svg { transition: translate 0.2s var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-link:hover svg { translate: 3px 0; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7ef6ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation Link
components.description: Condensed 15px link with a signal-to-magenta underline on hover and current page.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav a { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; color: var(--ink-muted, #a4aec4); font-family: var(--font-subhead, "Barlow Condensed", sans-serif); font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav a::after { content: ""; position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 7px; left: 12px; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--signal, #ff2d2d), var(--magenta, #ff2ba6)); box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 255 45 45) / 0.8); transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: left; transition: transform 0.24s var(--ease-out, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)); } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--ink, #f2f5fb); } .ds-nav a:hover::after, .ds-nav a[aria-current="page"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7ef6ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Square sunken well with a mono label and a red focus bloom.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; } .ds-field span { color: var(--faint, #727d95); font-family: var(--font-mono, "IBM Plex Mono", monospace); font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-field input { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 14px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, rgba(160, 190, 255, 0.3)); border-radius: 0; background: var(--sunken, #04050b); color: var(--ink, #f2f5fb); font-family: var(--font-mono, "IBM Plex Mono", monospace); font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-muted, #a4aec4); opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:hover { border-color: rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 255 45 45) / 0.4); } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--signal, #ff2d2d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 255 45 45) / 0.5), 0 0 24px rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 255 45 45) / 0.18); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--focus, #7ef6ff); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Live Panel
components.description: Square hardware panel with a rim, a bloom, and one animated signal edge.
components.html:
IGI Rampage

Early work, shared openly. Nothing to download yet.

In development · no release date
components.css: .ds-panel { position: relative; padding: 32px 28px; border: 1px solid var(--line-signal, rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.45)); background: radial-gradient(100% 80% at 100% 0%, rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 255 45 45) / 0.16), transparent 60%), linear-gradient(165deg, var(--panel-raised, #0e111c), var(--panel, #0a0c15)); box-shadow: var(--glow-panel, 0 0 0 1px rgba(255, 45, 45, 0.22), 0 18px 50px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.55)); color: var(--ink, #f2f5fb); font-family: var(--font-body, "DM Sans", system-ui, sans-serif); overflow: hidden; } .ds-panel::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -1px -1px auto; height: 2px; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, var(--signal, #ff2d2d), var(--magenta, #ff2ba6), transparent); background-size: 200% 100%; animation: ds-border-run 5s linear infinite; } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 10px; font-family: var(--font-display, "Tourney", sans-serif); font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.02; letter-spacing: 0.01em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-panel p { max-width: 34ch; margin: 0; color: var(--ink-muted, #a4aec4); font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-panel-meta { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 9px; margin-top: 22px; padding-top: 18px; border-top: 1px solid var(--hairline, rgba(150, 175, 255, 0.14)); color: var(--ink-faint, #727d95); font-family: var(--font-mono, "IBM Plex Mono", monospace); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; } @keyframes ds-border-run { from { background-position: 200% 0; } to { background-position: 0 0; } }

components.name: Status Dot
components.description: Seven-pixel red lamp with a ring, a bloom, and a 2.4s pulse.
components.css: .ds-dot { display: inline-block; width: 7px; height: 7px; flex: 0 0 auto; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--signal, #ff2d2d); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 255 45 45) / 0.16), 0 0 12px rgb(var(--signal-rgb, 255 45 45) / 0.9); animation: ds-dot-pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-dot-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.55; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-dot { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
The site behaves like a field terminal left running in a dark room: a perspective grid on the floor, a radar sweeping the corner, one red channel marker, and a thin HUD frame that never quite stops being an instrument. It is not game-marketing chrome and not retro-CRT nostalgia. It is a working console for a community that is honest about being early, so the interface looks live without pretending anything is finished.

The world is built from three planes. Terrain is the full-bleed hero canvas: grid, horizon glow, radar ping, scanline. Instrument is the panel language: hairline frames, cut corners, status dots, mono labels, a marquee of verified facts. Dossier is the readable layer: condensed uppercase display type and a calm sans body, on a surface dark enough that the red reads as light rather than paint.

Light mode is not paper. It is the same instrument under daylight: the ground goes cool white, the ink goes near-black, the accents darken to print weight, and the bloom collapses to a clean rim. Geometry, spacing, and hierarchy are identical in both modes; only the light physics changes.
keyCharacteristics: Night-terminal default with a fully remapped daylight HUD.
Signal red is an event, not a surface.
Cyan and magenta appear only as traces: sweeps, rings, secondary glows.
Cut corners and 1px seams instead of rounded cards and gaps.
One WebGL canvas carries the hero; CSS carries everything else.
Mono type is reserved for measurement, status, and controls.
Every strong effect has a static counterpart under prefers-reduced-motion.

rules.name: The Red Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Red marks one action per view and the live element in a view. If two primary buttons compete in one viewport, one becomes a ghost. Red is never a page background, a paragraph color, or a decorative fill.

rules.name: The Daylight Is Not Paper Rule
rules.body: Light mode is a bright HUD, not a document. Keep the dark geometry, cut corners, and scanline logic; retune the accents for contrast. Never introduce warm paper, beige, or sepia to signal "light".

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Tourney speaks, DM Sans reads, IBM Plex Mono measures. A sentence is never set in all three, and body copy is never uppercase.

rules.name: The Trace Floor Rule
rules.body: Functional text never drops below 11px; 10px is reserved for decorative, aria-hidden instrumentation. If a label needs to be smaller to fit, the layout is wrong, not the size.

rules.name: The Line-Break Rule
rules.body: Display lines are authored, not auto-wrapped: use an explicit break or two block lines so the headline never orphans a word. Keep a real space in the accessible text across the break.

rules.name: The Rim Light Rule
rules.body: Depth is declared once: a 1px rim plus an offset shadow. Do not stack a hairline border under a wide shadow and call it two systems.

rules.name: The Motion Budget Rule
rules.body: One canvas, one marquee, one sweep. If a new effect needs a render loop, it replaces one of these rather than joining them. CSS handles hover, reveal, and state transitions; the canvas is paused offscreen and under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Cut Corner Rule
rules.body: Corners are cut at 12px for controls and 14px for panels. A rounded corner is a different world; do not mix the two in one view.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: Tags and status chips are square with a cut or hairline edge. A fully rounded pill is reserved for nothing.

dos: Do keep red for one primary action and live signals; use ink, hairline, and faint for everything else.
Do author display line breaks and keep a real space in the accessible text across the break.
Do use the 1px-seam matrix for groups of equal items instead of separate floating cards.
Do pair every panel with a rim and an offset shadow; pair every strong animation with a static reduced-motion state.
Do keep functional text at 11px or larger, targets at 44px or larger, and the focus ring at 2px with 3px offset.
Do let the hero canvas be the only render loop; pause it offscreen and under reduced motion.
Do theme browser surfaces: red selection, red caret, signal scrollbar, styled placeholders.
donts: Don't use red as a page background, paragraph color, or decorative fill.
Don't warm light mode into paper, beige, or sepia; it is a daylight HUD, not a document.
Don't add a second canvas, parallax stack, or blur-heavy glass layer for depth.
Don't use gradient-filled text; emphasis comes from weight, size, and the single red word.
Don't round corners, build pill tags, or nest cards inside cards.
Don't put a color bar on the left edge of a card as an accent; use the rim and the seam.
Don't invent screenshots, fake terminal output, release dates, or stats to fill a composition; draw an instrument instead.
Don't set body copy in mono or uppercase; mono is a readout voice, not a costume.
